sources.title: Milanese dialect (English Wikipedia)
sources.reliability_notes: Overview only; carries maintenance tags (single-source). Used for orthography status: Classical Milanese orthography is the de facto standard, oeu = /ø/, doubled consonants mark short stressed vowels.

sources.title: Dialetto milanese (Wikipedia italiana)
sources.reliability_notes: Phonology/orthography table (classic Cherubini vs modern Beretta ü/ö), loss of passato remoto, infinitives in -à, 1sg present in -i, minga after the verb.

sources.title: Milanese grammar (English Wikipedia)
sources.reliability_notes: Page is partly garbled in extraction; articles, plural rules, suffixes, pronoun tables, possessives, prepositions, adverbs. Use with care: some cells blank.
sources.relevant_sections: Articles, Nouns, Pronouns, Possessives, Verbs, Adverbs, Prepositions

sources.title: Dialett milanes (Lombard Wikipedia)
sources.reliability_notes: Subject pronouns obligatory, te set / ti te set, negation minga/no post-verbal (older pre-verbal no in Porta), no gerund (son dree a / sta a + infinitive), participles staa/andaa/faa/daa, passato remoto lost, son dree a scriv.

sources.title: Lombard occidental (Lombard Wikipedia)
sources.reliability_notes: Articles el/la/i, pronoun forms mi/ti/lu/lee/nun(ch)/vialter/lur, clitic objects; notes that question inversion is dropped in Milanese; two orthographic traditions.

sources.title: Lingua lombarda (Wikipedia italiana)
sources.reliability_notes: Only the first ~200k characters read. Negation after verb or auxiliary (han no/minga/mia parlaa), subject clitics (luu) el dis, wh-questions with 'che', classical orthography oeu/u.
sources.relevant_sections: Morfologia e sintassi; Sistema di scrittura

sources.title: avè (Wiktionary, Lombard section)
sources.reliability_notes: Full Western Lombard/Milanese conjugation table of avè (present hoo, hé/hét, hà, hèmm, avìi/hii, hann; imperfect; future; conditional; subjunctive).

sources.title: fà (Wiktionary, Lombard section)
sources.reliability_notes: Present of fà in Western Lombard (fi, fet, fa, fom, fov/fee, fen); participle fàa; auxiliary avè. Summarised by the fetch tool, tables not read directly.

sources.title: minga (Wiktionary, Lombard section)
sources.reliability_notes: Adverb 'not'; from menga by hypercorrection; variants menga, mea, mia.

sources.title: pirla (Wiktionary, Italian section)
sources.linguistic_area: Milanese (Western Lombard), Milan and northern Italian
sources.reliability_notes: Only an Italian entry: regional, vulgar noun 'fool, idiot' and vulgar 'penis'; probably related to pirlare; plural pirli. No Lombard entry was found.

sources.title: Proverbi in dialetto milanese: significato e traduzione (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Popular web page; spelling mixes classical and ad-hoc conventions; some translations do not fit the text. Used only for short proverbs, with own paraphrase.

sources.title: Detti milanesi: espressioni, proverbi e modi di dire di Milano (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Popular page with 63 sayings; non-uniform orthography (e.g. oeu/öeu, accents). Proverbs generally corroborated by shape and by other sources only for a few.

sources.title: Parolacce in dialetto milanese: significato, traduzione e quando non usarle (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Popular list of insults and dismissals with warnings; spellings not standardised; includes slur items flagged discriminatory by the page itself.

sources.title: Glossario di termini milanesi: significato ed esempi d'uso (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Popular glossary of colourful words (balabiott, barlafus, ciula, malnatt...). Spelling as in source; no etymologies.

sources.title: Lingua milanese: pronuncia, grammatica e esempi (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Gives present of vardà (mì vardi, tì te vardet, luu el varda...), imperfect (vardavi), passato prossimo (hoo vardaa), older vs modern interrogative (Voeurela? / La voeur?).

sources.title: Vocabolario inglese-milanese: parole utili, pronuncia e frasi lampo (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Word list and three sample sentences (Incoeu gh'è tant gent in via; Me pias bev on bicer de vin; Te voret andà al mercaa duman?). Orthography mostly classical.

sources.title: Gergo milanese: parole ed espressioni del parlar furbesco (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Historical underworld slang (bauscia, ghisa, baloss...). Slang, not general Milanese.

sources.title: Modi di dire meneghini: il verbo sapere (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: About forty expressions around savè; the fetch tool returned a paraphrased selection only.

sources.title: Modi di dire alla milanese: il verbo andare (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: About thirty expressions around andà; paraphrased selection read.

sources.title: Curiosita nascoste del dialetto milanese: mestieri e parole d'epoca (MilanoFree)
sources.reliability_notes: Trade names (nodar, careghee, magutt, offellee); proverbs L'è on laorà del moleta and Offellee fa el tò mestee.

sources.title: Milanese: The Voice of Milan (elon.io)
sources.reliability_notes: Learner page; clitics te/el/al/la/i, negation minga after verb, hoo, voo, l'è, sample sentences, 'pirla' as a vulgar Milanese insult. Not scholarly.

sources.title: Proverbi lombardi (Wikiquote)
sources.reliability_notes: Only two entries, not labelled Milanese: El quattrin l'è quell che fa cantà l'orbin; Per la gotta è bon nagotta.

sources.title: Lombard language (English Wikipedia)
sources.reliability_notes: Only the first 100k characters read: Milanese in Western Lombard, contrastive vowel length (andà vs andaa).
